categorizers.name: demo-smile
categorizers.label: Demo: smile and open smile
categorizers.description: Made from the app's own three-second test recording of one face: a rest, a smile, a smile with the mouth open. Two faces; a face near the rest is none of these.

categorizers.name: demo-hand-shapes
categorizers.label: Demo: open, fist, point, pinch (hand shapes)
categorizers.description: Carved from one real signer's hands (SignAlphaSet, Garg et al., doi:10.17632/8fmvr9m98w.3, CC BY 4.0): an open hand, a fist, a sideways point and a ring, a loose cup as none of these. Reads some hands and not others; teach it your own.

categorizers.name: demo-poses
categorizers.label: Demo: arms up, an arm out, crouch (poses)
categorizers.description: Carved from the app's scripted body (no person): arms up, the left arm out, the right arm out and a crouch, standing at rest as none of these.
